<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that forms a bromide on an aromatic carbon. Use the product molecule bromobenzene (c1ccccc1Br) as the target and specify that a bromide functional group is formed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccccc1Br",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["bromide"],
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
